scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @pdftools/shared && npm run build -w @pdftools/pdf-core
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @pdftools/api && npm run build -w @pdftools/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @pdftools/api
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm test -w @pdftools/pdf-core && npm test -w @pdftools/api && npm test -w @pdftools/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck -w @pdftools/api && npm run typecheck -w @pdftools/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test -w @pdftools/e2e
